scope: Hardware reference only; user-confirmed custom infinite-spool firmware controls actual behavior. Flashed binary identity remains unverified.

sources.finding: Official linked pin graphic labels PB7 local ENDSTOP, PB5/PB6 signal connectors, PA6 motor EN, PA7 DIR, PC13 STEP, PB1 UART, main PB15 Fil-Switch and PB14 Fil-Motion. Does not label PA8/PA15 LED wiring. Asset directory name alone does not identify board.

sources.quote: After connecting the power supply, the indicator light on the buffer should remain constantly on, indicating the device is powered.

sources.finding: Official board photo/power diagram inspected including crop; visible R/B are pushbuttons, not established LED labels; no LED-net map established.
